description: 50 labelled enterprise RAG evaluation cases across 5 slices: 12 lexical_factual, 14 semantic_multichunk, 8 rbac_restricted, 8 stale_source, and 8 unanswerable_abstention.

cases.query: Under release gate GATE-AI-104, what minimum NDCG@10 score and RBAC Leakage Rate are required before production promotion?
cases.reference_answer: Under release gate GATE-AI-104, promotion requires a minimum NDCG@10 score of 0.82, a Passage Claim Support Rate of at least 0.85, and an RBAC Leakage Rate of 0.0 [DOC-AI-SOP-001#P1].

cases.query: What is the incident escalation code and response SLA when unsupported claims exceed 3.0% in 24 hours?
cases.reference_answer: If the unsupported claim rate exceeds 3.0% over a rolling 24-hour window, incident code INC-SEV2-RAG must be escalated to the AI Safety Lead within 4 hours [DOC-AI-SOP-001#P3].

cases.query: In specification SPEC-RET-208, what BM25 parameters and dense embedding dimension are mandated?
cases.reference_answer: Specification SPEC-RET-208 mandates SQLite FTS5 BM25 parameters k1=1.2 and b=0.75 paired with 384-dimensional L2-normalized dense embeddings [DOC-RAG-ARCH-002#P1].

cases.query: What smoothing constant k and cross-encoder model are specified for Reciprocal Rank Fusion in DOC-RAG-ARCH-002?
cases.reference_answer: Reciprocal Rank Fusion uses smoothing constant k=60, and the top 12 fused candidates are rescored by cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 [DOC-RAG-ARCH-002#P2].

cases.query: Under clause GDPR-ART28-ANNEX-B, which AWS region and breach notification SLA are required for subprocessors?
cases.reference_answer: Clause GDPR-ART28-ANNEX-B requires EU/EEA data residency in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt), a signed DPA, and a 72-hour breach notification SLA [DOC-GDPR-003#P1].

cases.query: What is the purge deadline under workflow ERASURE-SLA-14D for GDPR Article 17 erasure requests?
cases.reference_answer: Under workflow ERASURE-SLA-14D, FTS5 tokens, dense embeddings, and cached HITL records must be purged within 14 calendar days [DOC-GDPR-003#P3].

cases.query: According to schedule TIER-PROC-302, who must approve an AI contract with an ACV between EUR 50,001 and EUR 250,000?
cases.reference_answer: Under schedule TIER-PROC-302, contracts between EUR 50,001 and EUR 250,000 ACV require joint sign-off from the VP of Procurement and the Data Protection Officer (DPO) [DOC-PROC-004#P1].

cases.query: What does contractual clause CL-ZDR-09 require regarding foundation model training and buffer wiping?
cases.reference_answer: Clause CL-ZDR-09 mandates Zero-Data-Retention: prompts and outputs are never used for model training, and inference buffers must be wiped within 24 hours [DOC-PROC-004#P2].

cases.query: What does traceability control ISO-13485-CL-7.5.8 require when an underlying clinical SOP is updated?
cases.reference_answer: Control ISO-13485-CL-7.5.8 requires binding every clinical summary to source document ID, page number, effective date, and SHA-256 digest, automatically invalidating prior approvals when the SOP changes [DOC-MED-005#P2].

cases.query: Under control WAIVER-MAX-30D, what is the maximum duration of a temporary intake policy waiver?
cases.reference_answer: Under control WAIVER-MAX-30D, temporary intake waivers require a named approver and tracker reference and expire within 30 calendar days [DOC-SEC-006#P3].

cases.query: What are the three conditions under control HITL-DIGEST-801 that route a RAG response to pending_review?
cases.reference_answer: Under HITL-DIGEST-801, responses route to pending_review when any passage is stale beyond max_staleness_days, passage claim support falls below 0.72, or the query touches regulated compliance boundaries [DOC-HITL-007#P1].

cases.query: Under standard FIN-QUOTA-312, what are the daily input and output token caps per business unit tenant?
cases.reference_answer: Standard FIN-QUOTA-312 caps each business unit tenant at 2,500,000 input tokens per day and 400,000 output tokens per day with a 24-hour semantic cache TTL [DOC-FINOPS-012#P1].

cases.query: During a dark launch of a candidate language model in production, what statistical divergence threshold or response time slowdown triggers an automatic revert?
cases.reference_answer: During shadow deployment (canary silent parallel evaluation), a Population Stability Index (PSI) drift above 0.08 or CPU P99 latency above 450 milliseconds triggers an immediate circuit-breaker rollback [DOC-AI-SOP-001#P2].

cases.query: Why does our enterprise architecture require evaluating user role clearance at index query time rather than redacting confidential documents after final results are ranked?
cases.reference_answer: Pre-retrieval filtering (AC-PRE-01) is required because post-retrieval filtering lets unauthorized chunks displace authorized evidence from the top-k window and creates side-channel inference risks [DOC-RAG-ARCH-002#P3].

cases.query: How must European citizen fiscal IDs, medical coverage records, and wire transfer routing strings be anonymized prior to generating production vector representations?
cases.reference_answer: German tax identifiers (Steuer-ID), statutory health insurance numbers (KVNR), and IBAN bank numbers must be checksum-verified and replaced with salted SHA-256 pseudonyms before indexing [DOC-GDPR-003#P2].

cases.query: What open-source dependency manifest specification and maximum vulnerability severity score must a cloud vendor satisfy before contract approval?
cases.reference_answer: Vendors must provide a SOC 2 Type II or ISO/IEC 27001:2022 attestation and a CycloneDX 1.6 Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), with zero unresolved critical CVEs (CVSS >= 9.0) [DOC-PROC-004#P3].

cases.query: Can an enterprise neural assistant deployed in a radiology department independently prescribe patient therapy, and what physician approval rule applies?
cases.reference_answer: Under directive MED-MDR-704, clinical AI tools are strictly documentation and evidence-lookup aids and must never issue autonomous diagnostic or treatment orders; licensed clinician sign-off is mandatory for Class IIa and IIb workflows [DOC-MED-005#P1].

cases.query: At what recurring interval must deployed hospital software undergo regulatory field quality reviews, and what factual grounding floor is required?
cases.reference_answer: Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) audits run every 90 days and require a minimum NLI passage entailment score of 0.78 on every atomic sentence [DOC-MED-005#P3].

cases.query: Which cross-platform desktop wrapper runtime settings or executable code-signing certificate changes cause a package release to be blocked?
cases.reference_answer: Under RULE-ELEC-04, enabling RunAsNode or EnableNodeCliInspectArguments, setting webSecurity to false, stripping Windows Authenticode signatures, or changing the publisher subject triggers rejection or security review [DOC-SEC-006#P2].

cases.query: Which language compiler artifact formats and Java WAR or JAR recursion depths are supported when extracting software supply chain inventories?
cases.reference_answer: Standard SEC-GATE-511 inspects Go buildinfo, Rust cargo-auditable sections, Electron ASAR bundles, NuGet deps.json, Python dist-info, and nested Maven pom.properties up to 2 archive levels deep [DOC-SEC-006#P1].

cases.query: How does the compliance workflow guarantee that a previously authorized answer is automatically revoked if a source policy page is revised?
cases.reference_answer: Approvals are bound to SHA256(normalized_query || sorted_chunk_sha256_digests || answer_sha256); any upstream edit alters the chunk SHA-256 and transitions the status to invalidated_by_upstream_edit [DOC-HITL-007#P2].

cases.query: What automated rate-limiting penalty is triggered when an engineering division overspends its cloud foundation model quota by fifteen percent?
cases.reference_answer: Under CHARGEBACK-CC-77, cost centers exceeding monthly LLM budgets by over 15% are automatically throttled to quantized local CPU models until VP of Finance variance sign-off [DOC-FINOPS-012#P2].

cases.query: How does the retrieval pipeline merge sparse keyword hits and dense embedding matches when their raw similarity metrics have incompatible scales?
cases.reference_answer: Unbounded BM25 scores and bounded cosine similarities are combined via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) over ranks before cross-encoder reranking of the top 12 candidates [DOC-RAG-ARCH-002#P2].

cases.query: For an executive reviewing senior level-seven technical leadership packages, what is the yearly equity grant limit and corporate buyout cliff policy?
cases.reference_answer: Under HR-COMP-901, Band L7 Principal and Staff AI Engineers have an annual RSU refresh ceiling of EUR 85,000 vesting over 4 years, with 12-month double-trigger M&A acceleration and a 35% retention bonus [DOC-HR-008#P1].

cases.query: When an executive evaluates workforce downsizing separation benefits, how many weeks or months of pay per year of tenure and what job placement allowance apply?
cases.reference_answer: Schedule HR-SEV-902 provides 1.5 months of base salary per completed year of service (capped at 18 months) plus a EUR 6,000 outplacement transition stipend [DOC-HR-008#P2].

cases.query: What is the chief legal officer's unilateral dispute resolution spending limit and how much capital is held in escrow for European artificial intelligence compliance fines?
cases.reference_answer: Under LEG-RES-604, the General Counsel has autonomous settlement authority up to EUR 350,000 [DOC-LEGAL-009#P1], and RESERVE-EUAI-2026 holds EUR 4.2 million in account GL-9940-LIT for EU AI Act audits [DOC-LEGAL-009#P2].
